name: Momentum-IHT in weight space
tagline: Recover g_w from chain rule, EMA-denoise it, take a gradient step on w, hard-threshold to top-k, then map back to (u, v).

key_hyperparams.name: eps_s
key_hyperparams.role: floor for sqrt to keep u,v defined

key_hyperparams.name: bias correction cap
key_hyperparams.role: freezes EMA bias correction after step 1000

init_recovers: Plain GD on w when beta=0 and k=d (no thresholding)
diff_from_baseline: Replaces all four (S)GD/AdaGrad/Adam baselines with iterative hard thresholding in the recovered linear-weight space: extract g_w via the diagonal-net chain rule, momentum-denoise, GD step, top-k hard threshold, then re-encode into the minimal (u, v) representation each step. Sparsity k is read directly from the task config.

name: SignSim-gated SGD with momentum
tagline: Momentum SGD with per-coordinate LR boosted when sign(grad_u) and sign(grad_v) disagree (sparsity-promoting) and shrunk when they agree.
init_recovers: Plain SGD-momentum when boost = reduce = 1 and clip → ∞
diff_from_baseline: Compared to the SGD baseline, adds heavy-ball momentum and a sign-similarity gate: when sign(g_u_i) and sign(g_v_i) disagree the step is doubled (this configuration drives w_i = u^2 - v^2 to grow), when they agree it is halved; gradients are pre-clipped to ±1 to handle Rademacher label noise.

name: EMA-denoised w-space gradient flow
tagline: Recover g_w from the chain rule, EMA-denoise with beta=0.995, reconstruct grad_u, grad_v from m_hat and take a vanilla GD step.
formula: $$g_w = \frac{u\,\nabla_u L - v\,\nabla_v L}{2(u^2+v^2)+\epsilon},\;\; m_t = \beta m_{t-1} + (1-\beta)g_w,\;\; \hat m_t = \frac{m_t}{1-\beta^t}$$ $$u \leftarrow u - \eta\,(2u\,\hat m_t),\quad v \leftarrow v - \eta\,(-2v\,\hat m_t)$$
init_recovers: Plain SGD on (u, v) when beta=0
diff_from_baseline: Compared to the SGD baseline, derives g_w analytically from grad_u, grad_v, applies a slow EMA with bias correction (beta=0.995 to suppress label noise), then re-projects through the chain rule (2u m_hat, -2v m_hat) so the gradient flow stays in the diagonal-net parameterization. No second-moment accumulator and no hard thresholding.

name: Multiplicative mirror on (p, q) with sign gate
tagline: Mirror-style multiplicative update on (u^2, v^2) using Adam moments of g_w, gated by sign-consistency EMA, with floor-aware equal-mass pruning.

key_hyperparams.name: floor
key_hyperparams.role: clamp keeps p, q above the init scale

init_recovers: Adam on g_w in the (log p, log q) reparameterization when c, prune, clip, gate are disabled
diff_from_baseline: Compared to all (S)GD/AdaGrad/Adam baselines, runs Adam in the recovered linear-gradient space and applies the update multiplicatively on the squared parameters p=u^2, q=v^2 with opposite signs (mirror descent on KL geometry). Adds a sign-consistency EMA c that throttles steps in noisy coordinates and uses |c| to shave equal mass from u^2 and v^2 (suppresses cancellation). lr is scaled by 1/(1+delta) and a sparsity-density factor.

name: Coupled Adam with reverse-adaptive scaling
tagline: Adam-style with shared second moment over both u and v gradients and an inverted scale (sqrt(s) instead of 1/sqrt(s)) plus 100-step linear warmup.
formula: $$s_t = \beta_2 s_{t-1} + (1-\beta_2)(g_u^2 + g_v^2),\;\; m_{u,t} = \beta_1 m_{u,t-1} + (1-\beta_1)g_u,\;\; \text{(same for } m_v)$$ $$\sigma = \frac{\sqrt{s_t+\epsilon}}{\overline{\sqrt{s_t+\epsilon}}+\epsilon},\;\; u \leftarrow u - \eta\,\rho_t\,m_{u,t}\,\sigma,\;\; v \leftarrow v - \eta\,\rho_t\,m_{v,t}\,\sigma$$

key_hyperparams.name: beta1, beta2
key_hyperparams.role: first/second moment EMAs (second moment shared across u, v)

init_recovers: Adam-momentum SGD with no second-moment scaling when sigma is mean-normalized to 1
diff_from_baseline: Differs from the adam baseline in three ways: (1) second moment s is accumulated from g_u^2 + g_v^2 jointly (preserving u<->v symmetry); (2) the per-coordinate scale is mean-normalized sqrt(s) (multiplied, not divided), so active coordinates take larger steps and inactive ones smaller — meant to amplify diagonal-net sparsity bias; (3) a 100-step linear warmup throttles lr.
